text.description_html:
Laurey 74728, Aventura Satin Nickel Cabinet Pull

The Aventura Cabinet Pull has 5 inch mounting centers and a beautiful Satin Nickel finish. This Aventura Satin Nickel Cabinet Pull has an easy to care for design, making it an ideal handle for high traffic kitchen cabinets. The 5 Inch Satin Nickel Aventura Cabinet Pull is part of the Laurey Aventura Collection of transitional cabinet hardware.

This cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Aventura Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 74728 128mm Pull Aventura Satin Nickel:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Satin Nickel
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 5" (128mm)
  • Overall Length: 5-1/4"
  • Width: 1/2"
  • Projection: 7/8"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
